# Google Open Source Projects

> > Documentation hub for Google's open source projects including GoogleTest (C++ testing), Agent Development Kit (ADK), Google Summer of Code guides, and development tools.

This site hosts comprehensive documentation for Google's major open source initiatives, spanning testing frameworks (GoogleTest/gMock), AI agent development (ADK with Gemini), developer programs (Google Summer of Code), coding standards, and specialized tools for compression, UI automation, and system deployment. The resources serve developers working with C++, Python, Java, and other languages across Google's technology ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- GoogleTest - C++ unit testing framework
- gMock - C++ mocking framework
- Agent Development Kit (ADK) - AI agent development with Gemini
- Google Summer of Code (GSoC) - Open source mentorship program
- C++ testing and test fixtures
- Multi-agent systems and agent teams
- Python and Java development
- Google C++ Style Guide
- CMake and Bazel build systems
- Mock objects and assertions
- EarlGrey - iOS UI automation
- Snappy compression library
- Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol
- Open source development practices

## AI Agent Development

- [Index - Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://google.github.io/adk-docs): ADK: Framework for developing AI agents with Gemini and Google ecosystem
- [Python - Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/get-started/python): Python quickstart: Installing ADK and building first agent with Gemini API
- [Multi-tool agent - Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/get-started/quickstart): ADK quickstart: Building multi-tool agent with Python/Java and dev UI
- [Build your agent with ADK - Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/tutorials): Progressive ADK tutorials from basic to advanced agent development techniques
- [Agent team - Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/tutorials/agent-team): Tutorial: Building multi-agent Weather Bot system with ADK and Gemini
- [ADK with Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol - Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://google.github.io/adk-docs/a2a): ADK guide for Agent2Agent protocol in multi-agent systems (Python/Go)

## C++ Testing Framework (GoogleTest)

- [GoogleTest User's Guide | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest): Main user guide for GoogleTest C++ testing framework with primer & advanced
- [GoogleTest Primer | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/primer.html): Introduction to GoogleTest: writing C++ tests, assertions, and fixtures
- [Quickstart: Building with CMake | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/quickstart-cmake.html): GoogleTest quickstart using CMake build system and FetchContent
- [Quickstart: Building with Bazel | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/quickstart-bazel.html): GoogleTest quickstart using Bazel build system and Bazel Central Registry
- [Googletest Samples | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/samples.html): Code examples showing GoogleTest features from basic to advanced use cases
- [Advanced GoogleTest Topics | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/advanced.html): Advanced GoogleTest: assertions, failure messages, and test fixtures

## Mock Objects & gMock

- [gMock for Dummies | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/gmock_for_dummies.html): Beginner's guide to gMock: creating and using mock objects in C++ tests
- [gMock Cookbook | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/gmock_cook_book.html): gMock recipes: MOCK_METHOD, mocking techniques, and method qualifiers
- [Legacy gMock FAQ | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/gmock_faq.html): gMock FAQ: virtual methods, variadic functions, and MSVC troubleshooting

## Google Summer of Code

- [What is Google Summer of Code? | Google Summer of Code Guides](https://google.github.io/gsocguides/student): GSoC student guide: Introduction to open source mentorship program

## Developer Tools & Libraries

- [Welcome to the Google Dev Library | devlibrary](https://google.github.io/devlibrary): Content library of open source projects using Google technologies
- [snappy | A fast compressor/decompressor](https://google.github.io/snappy): Snappy compression library prioritizing speed over maximum compression
- [EarlGrey  Reference](https://google.github.io/EarlGrey): EarlGrey: Native iOS UI automation framework with enhanced synchronization
- [About glazier](https://google.github.io/glazier/setup/about): Glazier overview: Windows imaging and deployment automation framework
- [Install | AEUX](https://google.github.io/AEUX/install.html): Installation guide for AEUX plugin: Sketch, Figma to After Effects

## Style Guides & Best Practices

- [Google C++ Style Guide](https://google.github.io/styleguide/cppguide.html): Google's C++ coding standards for readability and maintainability
- [Preface: Building Secure and Reliable Systems](https://google.github.io/building-secure-and-reliable-systems/raw/pr01.html): Book preface on integrating security and reliability in system design

## Reference & Support

- [GoogleTest FAQ | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/faq.html): GoogleTest FAQ: naming conventions, assertions, and C++ testing questions
- [Using GoogleTest from various build systems | GoogleTest](https://google.github.io/googletest/pkgconfig.html): GoogleTest pkg-config integration for build systems and cross-compilation
- [sqlcommenter](https://google.github.io/sqlcommenter/faq): sqlcommenter FAQ: ORM support, database observability, and SQL comments
